articles.summary: Alcoa Corporation (NYSE: AA; ASX: AAI) (Alcoa or the Company) today announced that its Board of Directors has declared a quarterly cash dividend of $0.10 per share of the Companys common stock, to be paid on November 13, 2026 to stockholders of record as of the close of business on October 27, 2026. About Alcoa Corporation Alcoa is a global industry leader in bauxite, alumina and aluminum products with a Vision to build a legacy of excellence for future generations. Since developing the process that made aluminum an affordable and vital part of modern life, our talented Alcoans have developed breakthrough innovations and best practices that have led to greater safety, efficiency, sustainability and stronger communities wherever we operate. articles.summary: PITTSBURGH - On September 16, 2026, an employee was found unconscious at the Alumar smelter and was immediately transported to a nearby hospital for medical treatment but later passed away. The incident was determined to be a work-related fatality. Alumar has conducted and concluded its internal investigation into the incident involving lighting maintenance at its carbon plant. Alumar is also working with its partners and relevant authorities in their investigations. The incident underscores the importance of verifying required safety controls before any production or maintenance begins. We extend our deepest condolences to our colleagues family, friends, and coworkers. The loss of a colleague is deeply felt, and we recognize the lasting impact on everyone affected.
